semantics.all_claims: Each gate exactly once; explicit applicability reason; missing policy or gate never defaults to success.
semantics.applicability: Frozen observable policy determines applicability. ALL always applies. NOT_APPLICABLE is invalid for required applicable gates.
semantics.negative_findings: A supported FAIL statement can publish. Missing data constrains positive claims, not truthful UNKNOWN reporting.
semantics.numerical_cutoffs: Owned observable policies define scientific thresholds, units, coverage, uncertainty and support. No universal credibility score.
semantics.publication: Integrity defects or included unsupported/contradictory positive claims block; limited honest unknowns/gaps require LIMITED.

gates.name: Frozen scope
gates.rule: Reject stale revisions, altered accepted inputs and unpinned applicable policy.

gates.name: Source integrity
gates.rule: Exclude invalid assets; dependent finding UNKNOWN; fabricated lineage blocks publication.

gates.name: Physical semantics
gates.rule: Unknown body/frame/units/quantity prevents a supported metric.

gates.name: Spatial support
gates.rule: Restrict scope or UNKNOWN; resampling never upgrades source support.

gates.name: Coverage and quality
gates.rule: Apply versioned observable-specific denominator/minimum; no zero-filled nodata.

gates.name: Temporal support
gates.rule: Restrict claim or UNKNOWN for incompatible temporal quantities/support.

gates.name: Assumptions and proxies
gates.rule: Required material assumptions need acceptance; proxies stay proxies.

gates.name: Uncertainty and decision
gates.rule: Use frozen interval/nominal rule; disclose unquantified uncertainty and sensitivity.

gates.name: Numerical reproducibility
gates.rule: Reject nonfinite, unversioned, unreproducible or dimensionally invalid calculations.

gates.name: Source independence
gates.rule: Shared ancestry cannot count as independent replication or confidence upgrade.

gates.name: Independent experiment check
gates.rule: Independent recomputation required; no solver self-certification or search-cap infeasibility proof.

gates.name: Challenge resolution
gates.rule: Material unresolved challenge restricts dependent claims; review cannot waive it.

gates.name: Discovery and controls
gates.rule: Bound novelty to reference/search scope; preserve held-out/control and mission-sensitivity evidence.

gates.name: Mode and validation level
gates.rule: Reject synthetic/replay/live or S0-S4 laundering; no baseline S5 claim.

gates.name: Claim and export consistency
gates.rule: Reject contradiction, hidden required outcomes, false readiness and omitted material limitations.
